boundary: This gate verifies software traceability only: Run Simulation exposes the generated citylbm_run_manifest.json path, exposes the claim-gate boundary in Grasshopper, and records claim-boundary and formal accuracy-gate fields. It does not validate CFD accuracy or Rhino loading of the new GHA.
